description: Vendor laptop support matrix for Grintion-OS. DMI aliases and product families are matched case-insensitively with shell globs. Modules are loaded only when the running kernel provides them; packages are installed by grintion-driver-select --apply. Physical-hardware verification remains tracked in docs/HARDWARE-LAB.md.

features.wifi: Intel AX200/AX201/AX210/AX211/BE200, Realtek RTL8821CE/RTL8822CE/RTL8852BE/RTL8852CE, MediaTek MT7921/MT7922/MT7925, Qualcomm Atheros QCA6174/WCN6855 and Broadcom BCM43xx
features.storage: NVMe over PCIe, SATA AHCI, UFS and SD/microSD readers (Realtek RTS522A/RTS525A and Genesys Logic)
features.firmware: Intel and AMD CPU microcode, split linux-firmware packages per detected device, Intel SOF audio firmware, and EFI capsule staging through grintion-firmware
features.audio: Intel HDA plus SOF from Tiger Lake through Panther Lake, SoundWire links, AMD ACP3x/5x/6x, and Realtek/Conexant/Sigmatel HDA codecs with UCM profiles
features.ports: USB4/Thunderbolt 3 and 4, USB-C DisplayPort alternate mode, USB 3.x/2.0, HDMI/DisplayPort, SD reader, 3.5 mm combo jack and RJ-45 where fitted

vendors.notes: Covers ThinkPad, ThinkBook, IdeaPad, Legion, LOQ, Yoga and Lenovo V/Slim laptop families. thinkpad_acpi adds hotkeys, rfkill, battery thresholds and platform profiles; ideapad_laptop and think_lmi cover consumer and WMI-managed models.
